lines.t: [Atmospheric piano]
[Warm acoustic guitar entry]
[Slow build, cinematic string swell]
Older than the galaxy, older than the dust
You wrapped yourself in starlight long before the world was touch
A thunder in the silence, a ripple in the deep
A holy voice that wakes the soul from centuries of sleep
Beyond the highest mountain, beyond the fading sky
The Alpha and Omega stands, the Sovereign on high
[Pre-Chorus]
Can you feel the tremor in your chest?
A holy fire stirring up the rest
He is drawing near, He is drawing near
[Chorus]
[Explosive dynamic]
Awaken now, the Bridegroom comes!
Listen for the sound of the ancient drums
Turn your face to the morning light
The King is stepping through the night
Lay hold of Grace, fall at His feet
Where sovereign power and mercy meet!
[Verse 2]
Look upon the scarred hands, touch the wounded side
The love that bore the heavy cross to draw us to His side
No longer at a distance, no longer far away
He calls His sons and daughters out into the light of day
Listen close against His chest and hear the steady beat
A Father’s love, a sudden pulse, forgiving and complete
[Pre-Chorus]
Can you feel the tremor in your chest?
A holy fire stirring up the rest
He is drawing near, He is drawing near
[Chorus]
[Explosive dynamic]
Awaken now, the Bridegroom comes!
Listen for the sound of the ancient drums
Turn your face to the morning light
The King is stepping through the night
Lay hold of Grace, fall at His feet
Where sovereign power and mercy meet!
[Bridge]
[Pacing slows, sparse piano, building intensity]
Shout it from the valley floor!
Withhold your song no more, no more!
The Desire of Ages, the Promised Son
The veil is torn, the victory won!
[Cello solo swell]
[Chorus]
Awaken now, the Bridegroom comes!
Listen for the sound of the ancient drums
Turn your face to the morning light
The King is stepping through the night
Lay hold of Grace, fall at His feet
Where sovereign power and mercy meet!
[Outro]
[Soft acoustic guitar fade]
He approaches...
Awaken your heart.
[Fade to silence]
